purpose: Executable ledger for the `information-entropy-no-go` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Entropy-accounting rows make entropy budgets and inequalities explicit; they can cap or roll back entropy language but cannot by themselves identify a candidate.

entropy_rows.entropy_quantity_or_budget: generalized entropy, boundary entropy, mutual information, and code-subspace recoverability budget
entropy_rows.entropy_inequality_or_budget_rule: Declare the entropy, relative entropy, mutual information, generalized entropy, entropy-cone inequality, monotone, likelihood information, or coarse-graining budget being used; identify whether it is exact, approximate, holographic, thermodynamic, statistical, or custody-only.
entropy_rows.accounting_failure_mode: Failure can appear as entropy double counting, hidden sector/vacuum/state degeneracy, violated strong subadditivity or holographic inequality, untracked coarse-graining loss, Page-curve rhetoric without public denominator, or metadata counted as physical entropy.
entropy_rows.entropy_accounting_test: Check whether the entropy quantity is defined on the declared record object, whether subsystem/quotient/gauge/sector choices are stable, and whether the relevant inequality or budget survives negative controls and route-local residuals.
entropy_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer microscopic ontology, observed-sector recovery, or ToE closure from an entropy balance, generalized-entropy expression, mutual-information score, or entropy-cone membership unless the route-native quotient and public-record bridge are also declared.
